subscription_ratio: 1 transferable Right per 1 Common Share of common stock held; 5 Rights required to purchase 1 new Common Share. A Record Date Shareholder holding fewer than 5 Common Shares may subscribe for 1 full Common Share. Fractional shares will not be issued.
subscription_price: Per new Common Share: 95% of the average of the last reported NYSE sales price on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days; if that price is at or above the closing NAV per Common Share on the Expiration Date, reduced to $0.01 below that NAV. If the resulting Formula Price is below 90% of that NAV, the Subscription Price is 90% of that NAV. Estimated Subscription Price: $8.69 per Common Share.
expiration_date: 1/26/2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time, unless extended
oversubscription_rights: Yes. Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their initially issued Rights, except Rights insufficient to acquire a full Common Share, may subscribe at the same Subscription Price for shares not purchased by other Rights holders. If requests exceed available shares, allocation is pro rata based on Rights originally issued. Secondary-market purchasers of Rights are ineligible. The Board may eliminate the privilege through the fifth day following the Expiration Date. Excess payments are refunded within seven Business Days after the Expiration Date.
event_status: Commenced
security_description: New shares of common stock, par value $0.10 per share, of BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund, Inc. (Common Shares), purchasable through subscription Rights issued to existing Common Shareholders.
effective_date: Expected issuance date: 2/2/2026, unless the Rights offering is extended
available_options: Exercise Rights to purchase 1 new Common Share for every 5 Rights at the Subscription Price; Record Date Shareholders holding fewer than 5 Common Shares may subscribe for 1 full Common Share. Eligible Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise initially issued Rights may request additional unsubscribed Common Shares at the same price, subject to allotment and possible elimination of the privilege. Holders may sell or transfer Rights; selling any Rights makes a Record Date Shareholder ineligible for over-subscription. Holders may also leave Rights unexercised. Direct Foreign Shareholders seeking to exercise should contact the Information Agent for instructions; those seeking to sell should contact the Subscription Agent. Foreign Shareholders holding in street name should contact their intermediary. Exercised Rights are irrevocable.
default_option: Rights not exercised by the Expiration Date expire and cannot thereafter be exercised. Record Date Shareholders who do not fully exercise their Rights will own a smaller proportional interest in the Fund after the offering; all existing Common Shareholders will experience NAV dilution. The Fund may reject defective or irregular exercises unless it waives the defect or permits timely correction.
election_deadline: 1/26/2026 before 5:00 PM Eastern Time, unless the Rights offering is extended. The Subscription Agent must receive either a completed Subscription Certificate and payment or a notice of guaranteed delivery and full payment by that deadline; for a notice of guaranteed delivery, the completed Certificate must arrive by the close of business on the first Business Day after the Expiration Date. A broker, bank, trust company or other intermediary may impose an earlier deadline.

Holders may sell or transfer Rights; Record Date Shareholders may instruct the Subscription Agent to try to sell unexercised Rights if it receives their certificates by 7/8/2026 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern time, or the stated deadline if extended. Holders may also leave Rights unexercised. Foreign Shareholders will not be mailed subscription certificates; the Subscription Agent will hold their Rights pending exercise instructions and, absent instructions by the stated deadline, seek to sell them.
default_option: Rights expire on the Expiration Date and cannot be exercised afterward. Holders who do not fully exercise may own a smaller proportional interest and incur voting dilution; NAV per share may also be diluted. The Subscription Agent will attempt to sell certain unexercised Rights submitted for sale, Rights of Foreign Shareholders without timely instructions, and Rights remaining unclaimed because certificates were returned as undeliverable; a sale is not guaranteed. The Fund may waive or permit correction of defects or irregularities, or reject a purported exercise; subscriptions are not accepted until substantially all irregularities are waived or cured.
election_deadline: 7/15/2026 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern time, unless extended; the Subscription Agent must receive completed subscription certificates and payment by then, or receive a notice of guaranteed delivery and payment by then and the completed certificate by the close of business on the first business day after the Expiration Date. expiration_date: 7/21/2026 at 5:00 p.m. (New York City time), unless the Company, in its sole discretion, extends the exercise period or terminates it earlier
oversubscription_rights: Yes; holders who exercise their basic subscription rights in full may subscribe at $5.481 per Unit for additional Units not purchased through basic subscription rights, up to the number of Units available under their own basic subscription right (200% combined). event_status: Commenced; final prospectus supplement dated 7/2/2026, with rights distributed and exercisable beginning 7/2/2026
security_description: Units purchasable by holders of Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. common stock or Participating Warrants. Each Unit consists of 1 new share of common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, and 0.4388 of a Warrant to purchase common stock. Each whole Warrant entitles its holder to purchase 1 share of common stock. The shares and Warrants will be issued separately upon closing, subject to the Closing Conditions.
effective_date: Anticipated delivery of Units purchased in the Rights Offering: 8/3/2026 (shares held in brokerage accounts may take several days longer); issuance is subject to satisfaction or waiver of the Closing Conditions
available_options: Exercise any whole number of Rights to purchase 0.071193 of a Unit per Right at $5.481 per Unit by submitting the required documents and full payment before the deadline. Sell or transfer whole Rights, including through a broker or the subscription agent, subject to its stated processing deadlines and applicable fees. Decline to exercise Rights. Beneficial holders must act through their nominee, which may set an earlier deadline. Registered holders with foreign, Army Post Office or Fleet Post Office addresses must notify the subscription agent before 11:00 a.m. (New York City time) at least five business days before expiration and establish that exercise is permitted under applicable law.
default_option: Rights not exercised before the Expiration Date expire without value or compensation. A holder who does not participate retains the same number of existing shares or Participating Warrants but may have a smaller proportional ownership and voting interest. Late certificates or payments need not be honored. An insufficient payment, or a certificate that does not specify the number of Units requested, is applied to the maximum number of whole Units purchasable with the payment; an exercise with uncured defects or irregularities may be rejected.
election_deadline: 7/21/2026 at 5:00 p.m. (New York City time), unless the Company, in its sole discretion, extends the exercise period or terminates it earlier; the subscription agent must receive the required documents and cleared payment by then. subscription_ratio: 1 transferable Right per 1 Common Share of beneficial interest held; 4 Rights required to purchase 1 new Common Share of beneficial interest. A Record Date Shareholder holding fewer than 4 Common Shares may subscribe for 1 full Common Share. Fractional shares will not be issued; otherwise, Common Shares may be purchased only by exercising Rights in integral multiples of 4.
subscription_price: The Subscription Price per new Common Share is 95% of the average of the last reported NYSE sales prices of the Common Shares on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days. If that price is at least the NAV per Common Share at the close of NYSE trading on the Expiration Date, the Formula Price is reduced to $0.01 below that NAV. If the Formula Price is less than 95% of that NAV, the Subscription Price is instead 95% of that NAV. The estimated Subscription Price is $27.37 per Common Share; the actual price is not yet known.
expiration_date: 4/2/2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time, unless extended. The Trust may terminate or extend the Rights offering at any time for any reason before the Expiration Date.
oversubscription_rights: Yes; Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise all Rights initially issued to them, excluding Rights representing less than one Common Share, may subscribe at the same Subscription Price for shares not purchased by other Rights holders. Requests are filled in full if sufficient shares are available; otherwise, available shares are allocated pro rata based on the number of Rights originally issued to each over-subscribing shareholder. Shares are subject to allotment. Holders of Rights purchased in the secondary market and Record Date Shareholders who sell any Rights are ineligible. The Board may eliminate the privilege in its absolute discretion through the fifth day following the Expiration Date. Excess payments are refunded within seven Business Days after the Expiration Date.
event_status: Commenced; final prospectus supplement dated 3/10/2026 for a subscription period stated to run from 3/9/2026 through 4/2/2026, unless extended
security_description: Common Shares of beneficial interest of BlackRock Utilities, Infrastructure & Power Opportunities Trust, purchasable by exercising Rights issued to holders of its existing Common Shares of beneficial interest.
effective_date: Common Shares are expected to be delivered in book-entry form through the Depository Trust Company on or about 4/10/2026, unless extended.
available_options: Exercise Rights during the Subscription Period to buy 1 new Common Share for every 4 Rights at the formula-based Subscription Price (estimated at $27.37 per Common Share); a Record Date Shareholder holding fewer than 4 Common Shares may subscribe for 1 full Common Share. Eligible Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their initially issued Rights may request additional unsubscribed shares at the same price, subject to allotment and possible elimination of the privilege by the Board. Holders may sell or transfer Rights, including through a broker or with assistance from the Subscription Agent; a Record Date Shareholder who sells any Rights loses over-subscription eligibility. Holders may choose not to exercise Rights. Direct Foreign Shareholders should contact the Information Agent to facilitate exercise and the Subscription Agent to facilitate a sale; shareholders holding through a broker or other intermediary should contact that intermediary. Exercise requires a completed, signed Subscription Certificate and payment, or a qualifying notice of guaranteed delivery with full payment.
default_option: Rights not exercised by the Expiration Date expire and cannot thereafter be exercised. Holders who do not fully exercise their Rights will own a smaller proportional interest in the Trust; the offering will also dilute NAV per Common Share for existing shareholders. No fractional Common Shares will be issued; Rights may be exercised only in integer multiples of 3, with fractional shares rounded down to the nearest whole share. A Record Date stockholder who owns fewer than 3 Common Shares may subscribe for 1 full Common Share.
subscription_price: U.S. dollars per new Common Share: 92.5% of the average last reported NYSE sale price of a Common Share on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days; however, if that Formula Price is less than 90% of the average NAV per Common Share at the close of NYSE trading on those five days, the Subscription Price is 90% of that average NAV. The estimated Subscription Price is $43.64 per Common Share, payable initially; the final price will not be known when Rights holders exercise.
expiration_date: 6/17/2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time, unless the subscription period is extended
oversubscription_rights: Yes; Record Date stockholders who exercise all Rights issued to them, other than Rights that cannot be exercised because they represent less than one Common Share, may subscribe at the same Subscription Price for additional Common Shares left unsubscribed after the primary subscription. Holders who acquire Rights but were not Record Date stockholders are ineligible. Requests are filled in full if sufficient shares remain; otherwise, available shares are allocated pro rata based on Common Shares owned on the Record Date. Any excess payment is refunded as promptly as practicable.
event_status: Commenced; the subscription period commences 5/20/2026
security_description: New shares of Tortoise Energy Infrastructure Corporation common stock, par value $0.001 per share, purchasable through Rights issued to holders of its existing Common Shares.
effective_date: Common Shares are expected to be ready for delivery in book-entry form on or about 6/25/2026, unless the Offer is extended; the stated issuance date is 6/25/2026, unless extended.
available_options: Exercise the primary subscription: submit a completed, signed subscription certificate and initial payment of the estimated $43.64 per Common Share for 1 new Common Share per 3 Rights, subject to the fractional-share rule and the 1-share exception for Record Date stockholders holding fewer than 3 Common Shares; exercise may also be arranged through an intermediary or by timely notice of guaranteed delivery with payment. Eligible Record Date stockholders who fully exercise their issued Rights may request additional unsubscribed Common Shares at the same final Subscription Price, subject to availability and pro rata allocation. Sell Rights through usual brokerage channels or instruct the Subscription Agent to try to sell them; a holder may also transfer Rights by endorsing the subscription certificate. Holders may choose not to exercise, but unexercised Rights expire. Subscription certificates are not mailed to foreign Record Date stockholders; the Subscription Agent holds their Rights pending exercise instructions and, if none are received by the stated deadline, seeks to sell them.
default_option: Rights not exercised by the Expiration Date expire and cannot be exercised afterward. The Company honors only timely received, properly completed subscriptions; it may reject a purported exercise with defects or irregularities unless they are waived or cured within a period it determines. Common stockholders who do not fully exercise their Rights should expect to own a smaller proportional interest after the Offer. No sale of unexercised Rights is guaranteed; the Subscription Agent is instructed to try to sell them only in the stated circumstances.
election_deadline: 6/17/2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time, unless the Offer is extended, for the Subscription Agent to receive the completed subscription certificate and payment or a notice of guaranteed delivery with payment. Under a timely guarantee, the completed certificate is due by the close of business on the first business day after the Expiration Date (stated as 6/18/2026 unless extended). A broker, bank, trust company or other intermediary may impose an earlier exercise deadline.

subscription_ratio: 1 transferable right per 1 share of common stock held; 5 rights required to purchase 1 new share of common stock. No fractional rights or shares, or cash in lieu, will be issued or paid; fractional amounts are rounded down to the nearest whole number.
subscription_price: $59.00 per new share of common stock
expiration_date: 4/15/2026 at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, unless extended by the Company
oversubscription_rights: Yes; a rights holder who was a shareholder of record on 3/27/2026 and fully exercises its basic subscription privilege may subscribe at $59.00 per share for shares not purchased through basic subscriptions. If demand exceeds available shares, shares are allocated pro rata based on shares purchased through the basic subscription privilege, up to the amount each eligible holder requested. Excess payments are returned without interest or deduction.
event_status: Commenced; final prospectus supplement dated 3/30/2026, with the subscription period commencing 3/31/2026
security_description: New shares of M-tron Industries, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, purchasable by holders of its existing common stock; up to 713,362 new shares are offered.
effective_date: Shares purchased in the rights offering will be issued and delivered as soon as practicable after the expiration time.
available_options: Exercise the basic subscription privilege: submit the completed rights certificate and payment to purchase 1 new common share for every 5 rights at $59.00 per share. Eligible record-date shareholders who fully exercise their basic privilege may request additional unsubscribed shares at $59.00 per share, subject to availability and proration. Holders may direct the subscription agent to attempt to sell unexercised rights, or transfer rights to a designated transferee or a bank or broker; the agent's ability to sell depends on finding buyers. Holders may request a new certificate for unexercised rights or let rights expire. Registered foreign holders seeking to exercise must notify the subscription agent by 4/8/2026 at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, and establish that exercise is permitted under applicable law.
default_option: Rights not exercised by the expiration time expire. If payment by uncertified personal check is not received free and clear by the expiration time, the exercise is canceled and the rights expire null and void without compensation. Failure to meet the guaranteed-delivery requirements results in forfeiture of the rights.
election_deadline: 4/15/2026 at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, unless extended by the Company; the subscription agent must receive the completed rights certificate or a valid notice of guaranteed delivery and full payment by that time. The rights certificate under a notice of guaranteed delivery must arrive by 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on the first business day after the notice is delivered. Holders paying by uncertified check should deliver materials by 4/8/2026 to allow funds to clear.
